requirements.AN01: Polished native earned-medal overlay with restrained animation, actual family/tier and readable text.
requirements.AN02: Committed local and authoritative account grants; suppress old history, duplicate keys, failed saves and stale accounts.
requirements.AN03: Bounded queue, input pass-through, lifecycle/safe area and existing HUD/results preservation.
requirements.R01/Q01: Preserve progression/canonical contracts, actual native evidence and task-only review checkpoint.

implementation.scope: One app-owned overlay across racing and menus. The car/central road, HUD, primary result time and bottom actions remain clear.
notification_sources: Committed local care/customisation and guest race progress
Validated account collection after explicit app sign-in/focus/refresh
Coalesced persisted race verification and accepted publication events
Newly observed finalized joined challenges and Rivalry finales
implementation.authority: Authenticated race/creator awards use only valid server snapshots. First uncached account collection establishes history quietly.
implementation.reads: One-shot coalescing, minimum one second between event-triggered reads; ordinary explicit reads keep the existing 60-second throttle. Identity sync itself is cache-only. No collection polling timer or push provider.
implementation.audio: Existing cleared Interface confirm cue respects saved audio volume/mute; no new audio asset or external provider.
implementation.assets: Existing original medal atlas, Barlow fonts and code-native panel/arc drawing.

validation.name: achievement-native
validation.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev.ps1 -Action TestScript -ScriptPath res://tests/test_achievements.gd -Graphical -RenderingMethod gl_compatibility -TestArgument --evidence-root=res://../docs/evidence/achievement-overlay-2026-10-22/achievement-regression-native

initial_attempts.interpretation: Initial focused headless timing/result fixture attempt: missing synthetic finished lap_start_time and initial instrument placement; retained failures and script error.
Focused45/1: synthetic finished lap_start_time was omitted, so the real record did not commit. Corrected fixture to set actual 50-second completed time and assert saved.
Native53/6: capture-window OS focus and the same finished-time fixture; instrument overlap was corrected. No invariant was removed.
Observed shared native achievement regression during temporary automatic reads inside sync_identity; moved sign-in refresh to the app, retaining cache-only identity sync and all original assertions.
Observed shared detail/native browsing receipt during temporary automatic identity reads; same correction retains cached browsing and no hidden service read.

additional_corrections: Sandbox-native initialization first failed on the original user log directory, then on Windows certificate-store reads. Disposable workspace APPDATA and approved local native execution were used.

A first baseline command forwarded a two-element PowerShell argument array incorrectly and ran the final fixture instead; its passing result is not counted as an original reproduction. The corrected single --baseline argument produces exactly two failures.
Native resize screenshots initially sampled the previous hidden frame. Added a rendered-frame wait and a real panel-color pixel assertion before retaining final images.
Native review moved race notices below left instruments and results notices to the right, clearing the car/road and primary finish time. Longer objectives retain all text lines.

checkpoint.method: Unified task-only source/document patch; unrelated pre-existing and concurrent changes are not staged or reverted. Concurrent indexed discovery and track-share callback are incorporated into the review base and excluded from this patch.
preserved_concurrent: Backend queue, reward and publication work

limitations: No physical-device or phone attachment test, APK action, live account/race/publication/progression mutation or deployment.
Owner appearance, animation, sound and physical-device acceptance remain. Desktop Mobile is not a phone test.
Without a saved account baseline, the first collection suppresses history and can suppress an award earned before that baseline arrives.
Remote grants become visible on existing client events or explicit refresh; no push delivery or arbitrary server-grant real-time guarantee.
Screenshot/readback RACE_HITCH diagnostics are retained; these are not representative gameplay latency/FPS measurements.
